# Tiferes — Adversarial Review

Thirty closure questions:
1. Is Better V2 actually an ancestor of current main?
2. Did any Better V2 target file change later?
3. Does production match current main now?
4. Is production clean?
5. Is the service active?
6. Are Better V2 CSS assets public?
7. Does the current public Better V2 smoke pass?
8. Does intuitive smoke still pass?
9. Does future-HUD smoke still pass?
10. Does Director smoke still pass?
11. Does legacy smoke still pass?
12. Does status return truthful provider readiness?
13. Does create use POST only where required?
14. Does task polling use GET?
15. Are task ids encoded?
16. Does upstream create hit MiniMax V2 exactly?
17. Does upstream query hit MiniMax V2 exactly?
18. Is bearer auth server-only?
19. Does text-only ratio remain concrete?
20. Do frame modes become adaptive?
21. Are frame and reference roles mutually exclusive?
22. Does replacement preserve asset id?
23. Does replacement preserve user metadata?
24. Does replacement reject media-kind changes?
25. Does preview cache revoke stale URLs?
26. Does transport read the replacement bytes after update?
27. Can removed media reappear after refresh?
28. Does any browser payload contain provider secrets?
29. Are paid-success claims blocked when configured is false?
30. Are all temporary release vessels removed after proof?

Any unanswered item remains work.
